scope: Assistant-development classical reduced-order surrogate control, frozen before any POD validation outcome; established real-POD Galerkin method, not novel theory or student preregistration

teacher_inputs.parent_and_slice_isolation: Require the pinned input audit and exact disjoint parent/slice identities in the loaded training and validation labels

basis_construction.inputs: All raw and velocity-smoothed TRAIN teacher fields only; the second family additionally uses TRAIN teacher tangent fields
basis_construction.snapshot_normalization: For each complex snapshot divide both real and imaginary parts by sqrt(max(sum(real^2+imag^2),1e-20)); never normalize the two parts separately
basis_construction.column_order: All state real columns, all state imaginary columns, then (second family only) all tangent real columns and all tangent imaginary columns
basis_construction.state_tangent_weighting: Each complex snapshot is normalized independently using the same physical floor; equal numbers of state and tangent snapshots give equal aggregate snapshot weight
basis_construction.factorization: One float64 real SVD per basis family; ranks use prefixes of the same left singular vectors without refitting

galerkin_model.fixed_basis: Real orthonormal B, independent of model parameters and evaluation data
galerkin_model.offline_operators: K_r=B.T K B and D_r=B.T diag(damping) B
galerkin_model.model_operator: M_r(m)=B.T diag(m) B; A_r=K_r-omega^2 M_r+i omega D_r
galerkin_model.adjoint: lambda_r=solve(A_r.H,B.T P.T residual); gradient=omega^2 Re(conj(B lambda_r)*u_hat)
galerkin_model.claim: Analytically differentiated reduced-model objective; no fine-PDE derivative accuracy or certificate is asserted
galerkin_model.cache_identity: Canonical float64 model content bytes; factor keys also contain frequency. Fixed copied basis/physical operator coefficients do not change after construction
galerkin_model.cost_scope: Reduced r-by-r dense factorizations/RHS solves and full-grid-to-reduced assemblies/projections are recorded separately; reduced RHS are not fine-grid RHS equivalents

validation.criterion_reference: Exact same physical three-component, equal-parent development criterion as the pinned gradient-training protocol
validation.score: Equal-parent mean receiver relative squared L2 + equal-parent mean full-field JVP relative squared L2 + (1 - equal-parent mean aggregate inverse-gradient cosine)
validation.states: All pinned raw and smoothed validation states with unchanged teacher directions
validation.inverse_cases: All eight pinned original validation slices; all original source/frequency blocks and raw teacher observations, with unchanged precomputed exact aggregate gradients
validation.ties: First basis family in frozen order, then lower frozen rank
validation.numerical_scope: NumPy complex128 reduced solves versus float32 saved teacher channels; mathematical criterion is identical to FNO, with ordinary floating-point rounding differences
validation.selection_effect_on_fno_grid: None: the four-FNO selection remains unchanged
validation.heldout_evaluation: None until a separate explicit prospective comparator freeze before held-out outcomes

accounting.shared_offline_teacher_labels: Carry forward full train, validation and inverse-gradient teacher-generation counters from the pinned study; reuse does not make those costs free
accounting.basis_svd: Exactly one per family; state+tangent includes existing training tangent generation cost
accounting.neural_sgd: None; no equal-update or equal-training-time claim
accounting.hardware_load: Main neural training may run concurrently; no acceleration or inference timing benchmark is performed

reference.citation: Benner, Gugercin and Willcox (2015), A Survey of Projection-Based Model Reduction Methods for Parametric Dynamical Systems, SIAM Review 57(4), 483-531
